create_tilting_control.gui.tilting_prope: Each side of the bearing shows a colored gem, matching the columns above:
Set a Redstone Link frequency under a gem to bind that side.
Powering that frequency tilts the propeller toward its side. Scales with signal strength.
create_tilting_control.gui.tilting_swive: Each side of the bearing shows a colored gem, matching the columns above:
Set a Redstone Link frequency under a gem to bind that side.
Powering that frequency tilts the attached structure toward its side. Scales with signal strength.
Tilt directions follow the world compass, regardless of the swivel's rotation.
Tilt directions rotate with the contraption. Relative pitch to where it currently faces. Ideal for aiming.
create_tilting_control.gui.gimbal_propel: Each side of the bearing shows a colored gem, matching the columns above:
Set a Redstone Link frequency under a gem to bind that side. Powering it tilts the propeller toward that side.
Gyro Strength stabilizes the whole contraption and adds stress. It is capped by the bearing's current RPM; the full cap unlocks well below max speed.
On-Tilt Gyro sets how much gyro authority remains around the commanded axis while a tilt input is active.
100% keeps full stabilization; 0% fully frees the axis you are tilting on.
create_tilting_control.gui.linked_joysti: Right-click links or unlinks. Hold the control key to move the joystick.
Hold right-click to link and control at once.
Transmits four analog Redstone Link signals from mouse movement,
plus two full-strength modifier links on configurable keys (default S and W).
Right-click with an empty hand to link yourself to the joystick,
then hold the control key (default Left Alt) to move the stick.
There is a limited range for linking.
Deadzone ignores small motions; Max Signal caps the link strength.
Holds the used state on release.
All signals return to neutral state when you release.
create_tilting_control.gui.bidirectional: The handle stays where you left it and keeps its output until moved again.
Once you let go, the handle walks back to 0 at the Return Speed.
Hold right-click on the handle and drag the mouse to move it between -15 and 15.
Each direction has its own gem, matching the markers on the block: §bDiamond§7 and §cRedstone§7.
Only the side the handle leans toward emits its level; the block below is powered by either.
Set a Redstone Link frequency under a gem to also broadcast that direction's level.
create_tilting_control.joystick.linked: Linked to joystick - hold %s to control
create_tilting_control.joystick.busy: This joystick is in use by another player
create_tilting_control.joystick.already_: You are already linked to another joystick
create_tilting_control.joystick.control_: Controlling joystick - press %s or Escape to release
create_tilting_control.joystick.hud.exit: Release %s to exit - ESC to unlink
block.create_tilting_control.tilting_pro: A _Propeller Bearing_ whose spinning propeller can be _tilted_ in any direction
When R-Clicked with an empty hand
Assembles the propeller contraption. Click again while running to disassemble.
Opens the configuration screen: Which contains the four link frequencies used for tilting controls, and some misc. configurations
When a side's Redstone Link is powered
Tilts the propeller toward that side. A _stronger signal_ means _more tilt_, up to _Max Tilt_. Opposing sides cancel out.
block.create_tilting_control.tilting_swi: A _Swivel Bearing_ whose simulated attached structure can additionally be _tilted_ in any direction, while still receiving _rotation_ through the bearing
When R-Clicked with an empty hand
Assembles the structure in front into a simulated contraption. Click again to disassemble.
Opens the configuration screen: Which contains the four link frequencies used for tilting controls, and some misc. configurations
When a side's Redstone Link is powered
Tilts the attached structure toward that side. A _stronger signal_ means _more tilt_, up to _Max Tilt_. Plain redstone next to the bearing controls the _swivel lock_
block.create_tilting_control.gimbal_prop: A _Tilting Propeller Bearing_ with a built-in _gyroscope_ that keeps the whole simulated contraption _stable_
When R-Clicked with an empty hand
Assembles the propeller contraption. Click again while running to disassemble.
Opens the configuration screen: link frequencies, tilt settings, _Gyro Strength_ and the _On-Tilt Gyro_ multiplier

Stabilizes the contraption it is mounted on. Adds _stress_ per point of strength, on top of the per-sail stress. Higher _RPM_ raises the strength cap. Tilt inputs temporarily reduce the gyro on the tilted axis.
